jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027; the Law Society publishes two staggered closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) depending on the employer/university exam timetables, so no single close date is stated — offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027, and applicants must be in penultimate or final year.

Firm's careers page lists the NSW-aligned close of 11:59pm Sun 11 July 2027 and offers from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027, but does not state the application open date (applications currently closed); Brisbane dates are marked as to be released closer to the time.
Firm states applications are currently closed and will open in June 2027 for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program with a pre-registration option, but no exact open or close date is published yet.

jobs.program: Dive In (pre-penultimate insight program), May 2027 intake
jobs.notes: Allens states applications for the May 2027 Dive In program will open in March 2027 — open month only, no exact dates published; eligibility is pre-penultimate students (2nd/3rd year LLB or 1st year JD).
Firm confirms a 2027/2028 clerkship program will be advertised in line with the relevant Law Society/Institute guidelines in each state, but only the now-closed 2026/27 dates are currently published.

jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship & Graduate Recruitment — 2028 program cycle
jobs.notes: The QLS page currently shows only the 2027 cycle (applications opened 13 July 2026 and closed 5pm 7 August 2026, offers from 7 October 2026), so the next cycle's dates are not yet published — QLS recruitment typically reopens in July/August.

jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship & Graduate Recruitment — 2027 guidelines cycle
jobs.notes: Only the 2026 LIV Clerkship and Graduate Recruitment Guidelines (covering the now-closed 6 July – 9 August 2026 window for clerkships commencing 2026/2027) are published; the 2027 key recruitment dates have not yet been released on the LIV guidelines page.
